title: itembank report payloads
description: Two shapes, selected by which fields are present: a session summary (from 'itembank report' and runtime.session_summary()) and an objective history (from 'itembank evidence --objective' and evidence.objective_history()). Every count in either shape is post-retraction -- a raw line count of the evidence log overstates history, because D-10 undoes a response by appending a compensating event rather than removing anything.

auto_attempts.description: Count of responses with a non-null score

pending_manual.description: Count of constructed responses awaiting a mark

objectives.description: Objective name to {attempts, correct, pending}, unmapped responses grouped under the literal key '(unmapped)'

retracted.description: How many of this query's response events are suppressed by a retraction (plan 01-07). count is already post-retraction; this says how much of the raw log for this query was undone, so a smaller count is never mistaken for missing data. Optional: a document written before plan 01-07 has none.

by_mode.description: Plan 01-08, EVID-08's visible half. Mode name to {attempts, correct, wrong, pending}, counted over this query's events alone -- a drill-mode correct and an exam-mode correct live in different keys and are never summed into one figure. Optional: a document written before plan 01-08 has none.

index.description: Plan 01-08, D-08. Whether the disposable sqlite3 projection answered this query ("used") or could not be built/extended at all, so a full log scan answered it instead ("fallback"). Either way the answer is the same; this field only says which path produced it. Optional: a document written before plan 01-08 has none.

index_rebuilt.description: Plan 01-08. True when --rebuild-index deleted and rebuilt the projection before this query ran. The index is a cache (D-08); rebuilding it costs time and loses nothing. Optional: a document written before plan 01-08 has none.
